note: 26 hook formulas for Reels. A Reel has two hooks that fire at the same time and they are not the same sentence: the first thing you say, and the first thing on screen. The spoken hook has about two seconds. The on-screen hook has about one, because it is read before it is heard. Every formula here carries a template, a filled example, the on-screen version, what it is for, and the way it usually gets ruined. Each formula also carries a `match` regex, so the same vocabulary can name a hook found in the wild and not only write a new one. Walk them in `classify_order`, which is most specific first, case-insensitive.
rules: Write the spoken line and the on-screen line separately. On screen is the shorter, blunter one, six words or fewer, no punctuation it does not need.
No setup. The video starts at the sentence you would normally reach at second six.
Say the number. 'A lot' is not a number and neither is 'so much time'.
The first frame is a hook too. A static talking head at 0:00 with no motion and no text is three hooks wasted.
If the hook would work for anyone else in your niche, it is not your hook. Put the thing only you can say in it.
A hook promises something. Deliver it before the halfway mark or the retention you bought gets handed back.

hooks.name: Cost Confession
hooks.template: {Specific amount} is what {one mistake} cost me.
hooks.example: $18,000 is what one missing clause cost me.
hooks.best_for: Trust, fast. People finish the videos where you are the one who looks bad.
hooks.trap: A fake cost. 'It cost me my peace of mind' is not a number and everybody can hear that.
hooks.template_pt: {Valor exato} foi o que {um erro} me custou.
hooks.template_es: {Monto exacto} es lo que me costó {un error}.

hooks.name: Negative Command
hooks.template: Stop {common action}. Do {alternative} instead.
hooks.example: Stop posting three times a day. Post twice and reply to every comment for an hour.
hooks.best_for: Saves and arguments. The imperative gets attention that a statement does not.
hooks.trap: Telling people to stop doing something nobody does. The habit has to be one the viewer recognises in themselves.
hooks.template_pt: Pare de {ação comum}. Faça {alternativa}.
hooks.template_es: Dejá de {acción común}. Hacé {alternativa}.

hooks.name: Nobody Tells You
hooks.template: Nobody tells you that {uncomfortable truth about the thing they want}.
hooks.example: Nobody tells you that your first 30 reels are supposed to flop.
hooks.best_for: New audiences. It positions you as the person who says the quiet part.
hooks.trap: Picking a truth everybody already says. If the comments are agreeing before you finish, it was not a secret.
hooks.template_pt: Ninguém te conta que {verdade incômoda}.
hooks.template_es: Nadie te cuenta que {verdad incómoda}.

hooks.name: The Replacement
hooks.template: {This thing} replaced {expensive thing} for {price}.
hooks.example: This $12 tool replaced the editor I was paying $2,000 a month.
hooks.best_for: Demos and tool videos. The price gap does the work.
hooks.trap: Overstating the replacement. If it replaced 60% of the job, say 60%, or the comments will say it for you.
hooks.template_pt: {Isto} substituiu {coisa cara} por {preço}.
hooks.template_es: {Esto} reemplazó {cosa cara} por {precio}.

hooks.name: Time Collapse
hooks.template: This used to take me {long time}. It now takes {short time}.
hooks.example: Proposals used to take me five hours. They take twenty minutes now.
hooks.best_for: Process videos where the payoff is speed. Reads instantly on screen.
hooks.trap: A ratio nobody believes. 40 hours to 4 seconds gets treated as a lie even when it is true.
hooks.template_pt: Isso levava {muito tempo}. Hoje leva {pouco}.
hooks.template_es: Esto me llevaba {mucho tiempo}. Hoy lleva {poco}.

hooks.name: The Receipt
hooks.template: I {did thing} for {N days}. Here are the actual numbers.
hooks.example: I posted one reel a day for 60 days. Here is what it did to my DMs.
hooks.best_for: Experiments. Pairs with a screen recording of the real dashboard, which is the whole value.
hooks.trap: Not showing the screen. A numbers video with no screen recording is a numbers claim.
hooks.template_pt: Fiz {coisa} por {N dias}. Aqui estão os números reais.
hooks.template_es: Hice {cosa} durante {N días}. Acá están los números reales.

hooks.name: Wrong Way, Right Way
hooks.template: You are doing {thing} wrong, and it is not your fault. {The fix}.
hooks.example: You are writing captions wrong, and it is not your fault. Instagram hides everything after line one.
hooks.best_for: Teaching. The 'not your fault' half stops it reading as an insult, which is what kills this one.
hooks.trap: Skipping the absolution. 'You are doing it wrong' on its own makes people leave rather than learn.
hooks.template_pt: Você está fazendo {coisa} errado, e não é culpa sua. {A correção}.
hooks.template_es: Estás haciendo {cosa} mal, y no es tu culpa. {La solución}.

hooks.name: Insider Leak
hooks.template: I spent {N years} {inside the thing}. Here is what we never said out loud.
hooks.example: I spent six years selling agency retainers. Here is what we never put in the proposal.
hooks.best_for: Authority without a credential slide. Works only if the years are real.
hooks.trap: Promising a secret and delivering the brochure. The comments are merciless about this one.
hooks.template_pt: Passei {N anos} {dentro do setor}. Isto a gente nunca falou em voz alta.
hooks.template_es: Pasé {N años} {adentro del rubro}. Esto nunca lo dijimos en voz alta.

hooks.name: The Steal
hooks.template: Steal this {artifact}. It took me {time} to get right.
hooks.example: Steal this four-line follow-up. It took me two years and a lot of dead leads.
hooks.best_for: Saves and sends, which are the two metrics that move reach the most.
hooks.trap: The artifact not being on screen. If they cannot screenshot it, there is nothing to steal.
hooks.template_pt: Roube este {roteiro}. Levei {tempo} para acertar.
hooks.template_es: Robate este {itinerario}. Me llevó {tiempo} dejarlo bien.

hooks.name: If This, Then Watch
hooks.template: If you {specific situation}, this {short time} fixes it.
hooks.example: If your reels get views and no followers, the next 40 seconds fix it.
hooks.best_for: Qualifying hard. Fewer people stay, and the ones who do are the ones who buy.
hooks.trap: A situation so broad it qualifies nobody. 'If you want to grow' is not a situation.
hooks.template_pt: Se você {situação específica}, isto resolve em {tempo curto}.
hooks.template_es: Si {situación específica}, esto lo resuelve en {tiempo corto}.

hooks.name: Numbered With A Favourite
hooks.template: {N} {things} that {outcome}. Number {k} is the one nobody uses.
hooks.example: Five caption edits that double saves. Number four is the one nobody does.
hooks.best_for: Retention through the middle: naming a favourite gives people a reason to stay past three.
hooks.trap: N above seven. Nobody believes you have nine good ones, and you do not.
hooks.template_pt: {N} {coisas} que {resultado}. A número {k} quase ninguém usa.
hooks.template_es: {N} {cosas} que {resultado}. La número {k} casi nadie la usa.

hooks.name: The Objection
hooks.template: "{Objection they actually say}." Fine. Here is the version that works anyway.
hooks.example: "I don't want to be on camera." Fine. Here is the faceless version that still sells.
hooks.best_for: Selling to the people who already said no once.
hooks.trap: Inventing the objection. Pull it verbatim from a DM or a comment, including the bad grammar.
hooks.template_pt: "{Objeção que o cliente fala}." Justo. Aqui está o jeito que funciona mesmo assim.
hooks.template_es: "{Objeción que el cliente dice}." Justo. Acá está la forma que funciona igual.

hooks.name: Before And After, On Screen
hooks.template: {Show the old thing}. {Show the new thing}. {One sentence on the lever}.
hooks.example: This was my profile in March. This is it now. I changed the name field, nothing else.
hooks.best_for: Anything visual. The cut between the two frames is the hook, the words are secondary.
hooks.trap: Three levers. Name one thing that changed or the transformation stops being believable.
hooks.template_pt: {Mostre o antigo}. {Mostre o novo}. {Uma frase sobre a alavanca}.
hooks.template_es: {Mostrá lo viejo}. {Mostrá lo nuevo}. {Una frase sobre la palanca}.

hooks.name: The Callout
hooks.template: {Specific group}, this is the one you have been ignoring.
hooks.example: Photographers charging under $2,000: this is the pricing page you have been avoiding.
hooks.best_for: Cutting a broad audience down to the one that converts. Send rate goes up because people tag each other.
hooks.trap: A group so large it is not a callout. 'Entrepreneurs' is not a group.
hooks.template_pt: {Grupo específico}, este é o que você vem ignorando.
hooks.template_es: {Grupo específico}, este es el que venís ignorando.

hooks.name: The Flop Record
hooks.template: My first {N} {attempts} did nothing. Here is what changed on {N+1}.
hooks.example: My first 47 reels averaged 300 views. Number 48 did 400,000. One thing was different.
hooks.best_for: People at the start, which is most of the audience. High comment rate.
hooks.trap: Making the change sound like luck. If the answer is 'I got lucky', there is no video.
hooks.template_pt: Minhas primeiras {N} {tentativas} não deram em nada. Aqui está o que mudou na {N+1}.
hooks.template_es: Mis primeros {N} {intentos} no dieron nada. Esto cambió en el {N+1}.

hooks.name: The Verbatim Question
hooks.template: "{Question exactly as it was asked}" - I get this every week.
hooks.example: "How do I post consistently without hating it?" I get this one every week.
hooks.best_for: Search. A question typed the way people type it is what Instagram search is matching against.
hooks.trap: Tidying the question up. The value is that it is in their words, typos and all.
hooks.template_pt: "{Pergunta exatamente como chegou}" Recebo isso toda semana.
hooks.template_es: "{Pregunta tal cual llegó}" Me llega todas las semanas.

hooks.name: Head To Head
hooks.template: {A} versus {B}. I ran both for {time} and one of them was not close.
hooks.example: Carousels versus reels. I ran both for 90 days and it was not close.
hooks.best_for: Comments. People arrive already holding an opinion, which is the point.
hooks.trap: Refusing to pick. A comparison with a diplomatic ending is a video with no ending.
hooks.template_pt: {A} contra {B}. Testei os dois por {tempo} e não foi nem perto.
hooks.template_es: {A} contra {B}. Probé los dos durante {tiempo} y no fue ni cerca.

hooks.name: Cold Open Demo
hooks.template: {Start mid-action, already doing the thing.} Watch what this does.
hooks.example: Watch what happens when I paste a competitor's caption into this.
hooks.best_for: Screen recordings and anything with a visible result. No setup at all, the hand is already moving.
hooks.trap: A result that takes twelve seconds to arrive. If the payoff is slow, cut to it and show the wait afterwards.
hooks.template_pt: {Comece no meio da ação.} Olha o que isto faz.
hooks.template_es: {Empezá en plena acción.} Mirá lo que hace esto.

hooks.name: The Deadline
hooks.template: {Thing} changes on {date}. Do {action} before then.
hooks.example: Your top nine grid crops change the second you post a reel. Fix the covers first.
hooks.best_for: Urgency that is real. Platform changes, seasonal windows, policy updates.
hooks.trap: Manufactured urgency. One fake deadline and every future one is discounted.
hooks.template_pt: {Coisa} muda em {data}. Faça {ação} antes disso.
hooks.template_es: {Cosa} cambia el {fecha}. Hacé {acción} antes.

hooks.name: Permission
hooks.template: You do not need {the thing everyone says you need}.
hooks.example: You do not need a niche. You need one person you can name.
hooks.best_for: Relief. Very high save rate, because it removes a blocker rather than adding a task.
hooks.trap: Removing the blocker and putting nothing in its place. The second half is the whole video.
hooks.template_pt: Você não precisa de {aquilo que todo mundo diz que precisa}.
hooks.template_es: No necesitás {lo que todos dicen que necesitás}.

hooks.name: Mid-Sentence Start
hooks.template: {...and that is when {the turn}.}
hooks.example: ...and that is when the client asked for the money back. Three days after approving it.
hooks.best_for: Stories. Starting mid-scene makes the viewer feel they arrived late, which is a reason to stay.
hooks.trap: Never going back to fill in the gap. Deliver the setup by second eight or it reads as a mistake.
hooks.template_pt: {...e foi aí que {a virada}.}
hooks.template_es: {...y ahí fue cuando {el giro}.}

hooks.name: Contrarian Flip
hooks.template: {Well-known saying, inverted.}
hooks.example: Nice guys finish first.
hooks.best_for: Comments. The viewer has to stop and check whether they misheard you.
hooks.trap: Flipping a saying nobody says. The original has to be a reflex, or the inversion is just a sentence.
hooks.template_pt: {Ditado conhecido, ao contrário.}
hooks.template_es: {Dicho conocido, al revés.}

hooks.name: The Statistic
hooks.template: {N}% of {group} {surprising fact}.
hooks.example: 33% of high school graduates never read another book.
hooks.best_for: Sends. A number a person can repeat at dinner gets sent to somebody.
hooks.trap: A statistic you cannot source. Say where it came from in the video or do not use it.
hooks.template_pt: {N}% dos {grupo} {fato surpreendente}.
hooks.template_es: El {N}% de los {grupo} {dato sorprendente}.

hooks.name: The Reveal
hooks.template: This is the new {thing}.
hooks.example: This is the new Sony point and shoot, and it fixes the one thing I hated.
hooks.best_for: Anything physical or visual. The object is the hook and the words are captions on it.
hooks.trap: Holding the thing up without saying what it changes. A reveal with no stake is an advert.
hooks.template_pt: Este é o novo {coisa}.
hooks.template_es: Este es el nuevo {cosa}.

hooks.name: Someone Else's Result
hooks.template: There was one {person} who {outcome} in {time}.
hooks.example: There was one creator who grew a million subscribers in a single month.
hooks.best_for: Proof when the user does not have their own number yet. Third-person is allowed if it is true.
hooks.trap: No name and no link. An anonymous miracle is a rumour.
hooks.template_pt: Teve um {hóspede} que {resultado} em {tempo}.
hooks.template_es: Hubo un {huésped} que {resultado} en {tiempo}.

hooks.name: The Superlative
hooks.template: The {fastest / biggest / only} {thing} is {the answer}.
hooks.example: The fastest way to get confident is to build evidence you cannot argue with.
hooks.best_for: One-claim videos with no story attached. It is the most common shape in the wild and the easiest to write badly.
hooks.trap: A superlative with a soft answer. If the second half is 'consistency', you have said nothing and the comments will tell you.
hooks.template_pt: O {mais rápido / melhor / único} {coisa} é {a resposta}.
hooks.template_es: El {más rápido / mejor / único} {cosa} es {la respuesta}.

note_i18n: match_pt and match_es are the Portuguese and Spanish classifiers used by swipe.py. They were written from tourism and hospitality phrasing and have NOT been validated against a real corpus the way the English ones were. Treat their hit rate as unknown.
